summary: Verified both bug fixes in the GalaxyNotes handwriting screen three-dot (paper) menu on PHONE (390x844) and TABLET (1024x768) viewports. FIX #1: Inline 4-chip toolbar-position row (top/bottom/left/right) is present inside the paper menu; the old draw-menu-toolbar row is gone; tapping a chip switches the toolbar immediately without opening any sub-modal and keeps the paper menu open; active chip renders with the brand color background. FIX #2: Menu card measures 260px wide, sits 4.0px from the right edge and starts within 2px of the three-dot button's bottom edge on both viewports — well within the ≤16px vertical-gap target. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: State variable showSubToolbar (line 420) is still declared but the sub-modal was removed (see comment at line 2745). Consider deleting the unused state to reduce dead code.

Console warnings observed (not blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). These are cosmetic RN 0.7x/web warnings but should be addressed in a future pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Handwriting screen is at /draw/{id}. Use existing handwriting notes from GET /api/notes (filter note_type=='handwriting'). Paper (three-dot) menu opens via testID draw-more. Inline toolbar chips: toolbar-pos-top/bottom/left/right. Menu card is a Pressable inside a Modal with borderRadius, width 260, positioned top: insets.top + 40, right: 4. Auto-detected by walking up from a chip element to the first absolute+borderRadius parent.
rca_of_issue:
N/A — verification pass, no bugs found. Both fixes match spec:
- FIX #1 code (lines 2338-2379): 4 chips rendered as flex-row segmented control with testID `toolbar-pos-${pos}`; onPress calls update({toolbarPosition}) without dismissing showPaperMenu; active state uses colors.brand background.
- FIX #2 code (lines 2260-2275): position absolute, top: insets.top + 40, right: 4, width: 260. Measured runtime values match: cardRight=386 vs winW=390 (gap 4px, phone) and cardRight=1020 vs winW=1024 (gap 4px, tablet). Vertical gap = card.top(40) - draw-more.bottom(42) = -2px (tight overlap, well under 16px target).
